claims.text: Each yes answer scores one point; a score of 2 or more means anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa is likely.
claims.quote: One point is given for every “yes” answer; a score of 2 or more indicates the patient likely has anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa.

claims.text: Read the result in context, since patients may withhold key information.
